question: The equipment ‘Shuttlecock' is required in which sports?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Badminton.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shuttlecock **is a** small, feathered projectile** that is used in the sport of **Badminton.**
 
• Badminton is a **racquet sport** that is played by **two or four players** who hit the shuttlecock back and forth over a high net using their racquets.
 
• The objective of the game is to hit the shuttlecock in such a way that it lands in the** opponent's court **and they are unable to return it.
 
• The game requires** agility, speed, and quick reflexes**, and is played both indoors and outdoors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball **is a team sport in which **two teams of five players** each attempt to score points against the other by launching a ball over a hoop that is **300 cm (10 ft) high **(the "basket") while following set regulations. 
 
• Any of several games played on a** rectangular table** with a set quantity of **little balls and a long stick** called a cue are referred to as** billiards.**
 
• In the bat-and-ball game of** baseball**, **two teams of nine players **each alternate between batting and fielding.
